findings.title: Binary diff SHA-256 mismatch between RTK-normalized and raw Git output domains
findings.body: Auditor recomputed raw Git patch SHA-256 665dacc300b00b4c88b78f1efcc962ac2295f05f40493392d72b2bea7ae1e64c while packet and operator receipt recorded 5dee0a6410608cdf310c1370941a778c8ccd3d5755ef1a438aef09b705ea7ad9. Deterministic follow-up reproduced 665dacc3 with `rtk proxy git diff` and 5dee0a64 with mandatory `rtk git diff`, proving an RTK output-normalization domain split. Substantive diff, commit, tree, ancestry, and paths match. Risk remains open because packet did not name hash domain.

findings.title: Substantive, test, runtime, scope, packet, and secret checks
findings.body: Auditor verified production one-line removal, real-SDK subprocess isolation, protected-file non-change, exact two-file commit, historical ImportError receipt, locked and 1.19 test receipts, image/runtime/MCP/workspace receipts, provider non-execution, foreign-container identity, late packet disclosure, amendment UNKNOWN handling, secret scan, and canonical packet hash. Full itemized findings remain in AUDITOR_REPORT.md and review_bundle/AGY_RAW_OUTPUT.json.
